title: Messages
description: Curated message pools for a scenario pack, generated offline (LLM-assisted, human-reviewed) and committed to git. The simulator samples them at runtime with the seeded RNG, so runs stay reproducible while content stays varied. Bucket keys are '<channel>.<kind>[.<phase>]'. Placeholders: {zone} is replaced with the zone display name; {original} (rumor buckets) with a snippet of the echoed signal's content.

buckets.description: Bucket name -> list of message templates. Names used by the simulator: call.witness.rising, call.trapped.severe, call.warned.severe_warned, call.noise, social.witness.rising, social.witness.severe, social.warned.severe_warned, social.rumor, social.noise, news.report.severe, news.noise.
